translations.translatedText: # Monday 27.9.2021 (radio)
Food aid for poor people ends up abroad. The number of police is to be reduced. Many fields have a labour shortage. The SPD was the most popular in the German parliamentary elections. The weather.
## Food aid
![People in a bread queue](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5874168)
Open image viewer
There are many organisations in Finland that distribute food aid. Photo: YLE
Food aid for poor people ends up abroad from Finland.

Yle's MOT reports that already a million kilos of surplus food is exported from Finland abroad each year. The food is mainly sent to the Baltic countries. In Estonia at least, money is also asked for Finnish donated food.

In Finland tax-payers' money is also used for food aid. Next year about a couple of million euros of state money will be used for food aid. In addition, support comes through municipalities and the EU.
Henna Leppämäki, a special expert at the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health, says that if food is taken out of the country, state support may not be used for it.
## Number of police
![Police badge](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-82267560cc4ba6b8b79/1624001494)
Open image viewer
The number of police will decrease next year. Photo: Timo Nykyri / Yle
The number of police is to be reduced.
Police Chief Seppo Kolehmainen says that next year there may be up to 250 fewer police than now. The number of places on police college courses may also be reduced.

The number of police must be reduced, because the money is not enough. This year about 838 million euros will be used for police operations. In the state's proposed budget for next year, about 808 million euros has been granted to the police.
## Occupational barometer
![A welder at work](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11189598)
Open image viewer
There is a shortage of welders. Photo: Mikko Koski / Yle
About 50 different occupations suffer from a labour shortage. The Ministry of Employment and the Economy's occupational barometer says that there is a shortage of, for example, cleaners and welders.
The greatest labour shortage is in health care and social work occupations. There is a shortage of, for example, nurses, doctors, speech therapists and psychologists.
By contrast, there is an oversupply especially of secretaries, tailors and professionals in the media, printing, art and culture sectors.
SPD won the German elections
## German elections
![SPD's Olaf Scholz at the election party](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3000,h_1688,x_0,y_309/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8586606150ad5058107/1632677275)
Open image viewer
Olaf Scholz is the SPD's candidate for chancellor. Photo: Focke Strangmann / EPA

In Germany the social democratic SPD party has won the parliamentary elections. The SPD got about 26 per cent of the votes. The Christian Democrats got the second most votes, about 24 per cent. The result is, however, historically bad for the Christian Democrats.
The new federal chancellor, that is the prime minister, will only be decided in the government negotiations. Difficult government negotiations are expected.
The SPD's chancellor candidate Olaf Scholz has said that he wants to form a government together with the Greens and the liberal party FDP.
## Tuesday's weather
![Finland's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12117818)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
Tomorrow, Tuesday, it is dry across the whole country. In the north the sun shines, elsewhere it is cloudier.
The daytime temperature is between 10 and 15 degrees.
